historical_fixture.text:
Fixtures below are reproducible **scenario definitions**, not retained generated
Sets or original runs. Use two audio tracks A/B with distinguishable source
material, a MIDI track M, and matching compatible clips where stated. Default
transport is stopped, Automation Mode off and grid fixed at one beat; preference
and linked membership are stated per case. Physical file/audio assertions require
a future retained fixture and comparator before any execution can count as pass.

positive_contexts: Future independently owned valid nonempty asymmetric audio/MIDI clips and separately eligible matching tracks; no fixture media supplied.
Record actual focus, offered feature, version/platform, selection, grid/quantization, transport/record/arm, preference and linked membership. Per-case active context overrides stopped default.

Before every suppression/stop/bypass/no-effect case require genuine actually running nonempty productive operation and nonmuted audible output; flags, eligibility or failed baselines are insufficient and remain U.

Before any failure/boundary/cancel/lifecycle probe establish independently valid successful admitted input/operation/path on a separate reset. No disk exhaustion, destructive file/account/hardware setup performed.
Each compound case is separate reset trials; unavailable/failed admission remains U and never passes a negative case.
